description_en: Queries the accelerated domain names that are protected by WAF. This operation supports fuzzy search
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafDomains获取接入WAF防护的加速域名，支持模糊搜索
name: DescribeDcdnWafDomains

parameters.help_en: The query conditions for a fuzzy search of accelerated domain names. The value must be a JSON string. For example: {"DomainNameLike":"example.com"}
parameters.help_zh:
设置查询条件，支持域名模糊匹配过滤。
```QueryArgs={"DomainNameLike":"加速域名"}```
parameters.name: query_args

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。取值范围为：1~100000。

默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of accelerated domain names per page. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的域名个数，默认值20，取值范围：1~500之间的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size
